mechanism: Both drugs are hepatotoxic and can cause elevated liver enzymes; leflunomide's active metabolite A771726 undergoes hepatic metabolism, and concurrent use increases risk of hepatic injury and bone marrow suppression.
action: Monitor liver function tests (AST, ALT, albumin, bilirubin) and complete blood counts regularly; consider alternative DMARD if hepatic impairment develops or if baseline liver disease exists.
